summary: st-test started by a seat outside its lane builds in the seat's lane, which the daemon names (st agents lane)

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: A check st-test runs outside every build cap, for a caller that names a seat (ST_AGENT) whose capped lane is on this host, runs in a scope in that lane instead of builds.slice. Checks that ran in place still do.

compatibility.detail: New local daemon route GET /v1/agents/lane and CLI command st agents lane; nothing replicates. An older daemon or CLI cannot name the lane, so st-test takes builds.slice as before and says why. Signed notes are unchanged: the recorded command does not include the scope.

downtime.detail: The CLI command needs the new daemon; st-test changes on its next run.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. A seat may still start its job units with --slice="$FRACTAL_LANE_SLICE" (docs/st3/seat-lanes.md); st-test no longer depends on it.

recovery.detail: Reverting puts a seat's unit started outside its lane back in builds.slice for its checks.
